summary: BHP Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Mark Vassella as a Non-executive Director effective 1 June 2026. Mr. Vassella, former CEO of BlueScope Steel, brings over 40 years of global steel industry experience. This is a routine board appointment and does not constitute a forced or abrupt management change, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, disclosing a normal governance update.
